title: 政策转向结构性支持：消费信心修复需五年，汇丰首席解读
speaker: Jing Liu

segments.en: well the party we were meeting on the surface it looks like the top policy makers are still more or less comfortable with a current development but it does signal there should be more counter-signical measures and there's room for incremental policies
segments.zh: 政治局会议表面上显示高层对当前发展基本满意，但确实信号表明应有更多逆周期措施，增量政策有空间。

segments.en: and in our view the incremental policy might be tealed towards as we mentioned helping the local government rather than the direct spending support for the consumers why the I guess the question that arises
segments.zh: 我们认为增量政策可能偏向帮助地方政府，而非直接支持消费者支出。这引发了一个问题……

segments.en: in one part of the market is there seems to be a lack of I wouldn't call a lack of urgency because that does didn't know that there's an urgent need to spend but why do you think it's more longer term the focus now than it is to shore up growth over the short term right
segments.zh: 市场上有人认为缺乏紧迫感，但并非没有紧迫需求。为什么您认为当前更注重长期而非短期增长？

segments.en: so I think we have seen this year different kind of policy announcement regarding how to support the consumption yes it seems like they have changed their stance from the kind of a technical support like the trading program cash handout etc to a more structural one
segments.zh: 今年我们看到各种支持消费的政策，似乎从技术性支持（如以旧换新、现金补贴）转向更结构性的政策。

segments.en: so they want to make sure people are confident about the future they have good jobs they have income expectation such that they're more comfortable to spend this is a direction to go in the longer term
segments.zh: 他们希望确保人们对未来有信心，有好的工作和收入预期，从而更愿意消费。这是长期方向。

segments.en: they publish the 15 year plan and specifically consumption 15 year plan and also basically how to equalize the access to basic public services based on permanent residence I think those things will take time to actually filter through
segments.zh: 他们发布了十五年规划，特别是消费十五年规划，以及如何基于常住人口均等化基本公共服务。这些需要时间才能见效。

segments.en: probably within the next five years we're going to see changes but unlikely to happen within
segments.zh: 未来五年内我们可能会看到变化，但不太可能立即发生。
